_source: catalogItems(category: site_from_template) -> CatalogItemsResponse { success, message, error, metadata, data: [CatalogItemEntity!] }. THIS FILE IS THE LIVE RESPONSE, COPIED VERBATIM from a real call to http://localhost:3067/graphql on 2026-08-14 - name, slug, tagline, templateKey, tier names and every price are the running server's own values from catalog-seeder.service.ts, not values a screen invented. The catalogue answers with exactly ONE item today, which is the fact the whole middle level exists to survive: an open set with one member. fulfillmentKind reads 'expert_site_provisioned', a DEPRECATED enum member that is nonetheless what the seeded row holds - the fixture uses what the wire says, not what the enum recommends. NO empty state: a catalogue that answers nothing is not a state this product has. NO refused state: catalogItems is a plain find and cannot throw.
